caveat: Hash-key overlap is not dialogue coverage: old data includes segments and OCR variants, new keys include speaker-labelled and speakerless variants; different wording and cue splits do not share hashes.

actual_matcher_comparison.method: App exact matcher, including first speaker removal and supported contraction/expansion; approximate search disabled. This measures old pack recognition of new captions, not new coverage of the old archive.

speaker_label_analysis.note: Counts retain the original unique-caption denominator and include existing matches. Exact matching only; no fuzzy matching. Removing labels tests hash compatibility, not semantic equivalence or missing dialogue coverage.
